scripts.build: tsc --build && tsc -p packages/gui/tsconfig.web.json && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('packages/cli/dist/index.js', 0o755)" && npm run build:web -w @perftracker/gui
scripts.open: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js open
scripts.release: npm run build && npm publish -w @perftracker/core --access public && npm publish -w @perftracker/gui --access public && npm publish -w perftracker
